summary: Lists the documents that specify the official protocols used in the Internet, with comments on revisions or changes planned. It is a status report that replaces RFC 961, RFC 944 and RFC 924, and was replaced by RFC 1011.

eli5.summary: It is a reading list that tells you which rulebooks the Internet officially follows and which ones are about to change.
